article.headline: Meta's SAM3 Arrives on Mac as mlx-vlm Expands Its Reach
article.lede: With eleven merged pull requests and a terse release note, Blaize Appolinary has shipped **mlx-vlm v0.4.2** — adding Meta's SAM3 segmentation model, a Chinese-platform document-OCR system, and fixes for four other vision-language families to Apple Silicon Macs. The update is a compact but telling snapshot of how quickly the open-weights ecosystem is targeting consumer hardware. What once required a rack of Nvidia GPUs is increasingly a `pip install` away on a laptop.
article.body:
The foundation is *MLX*, Apple's (AAPL) open-source array framework purpose-built for Apple Silicon. Unlike PyTorch or JAX, which were designed for discrete GPU memory, MLX exploits the *unified memory architecture* of Apple's M-series chips, where CPU and GPU share a single pool of RAM with no copy overhead. This makes it practical to run large models that would otherwise require a dedicated Nvidia card — a 24-gigabyte MacBook Pro can hold a *quantized* 24-billion-parameter model in memory alongside the operating system. **mlx-vlm** is the primary library for running *vision-language models* via MLX; at version 0.4.2 it supports over thirty model families.

The most significant addition is **SAM3**, Meta Platforms' (META) successor to the widely-used SAM2. Where SAM2 required users to click points or draw boxes to identify objects, SAM3 introduces *open-vocabulary promptable segmentation* — the model can segment every instance of a concept described in plain text, across four million distinct categories. The v0.4.2 release also adds real-time label drawing for SAM3's mask-only mode: labels now render correctly whether or not bounding boxes are displayed, a small but practical refinement for video annotation workflows.

Also new is DOTS-MOCR, a three-billion-parameter *multimodal OCR* model from rednote-hilab, the AI research arm of Xiaohongshu (the Chinese lifestyle platform known internationally as RedNote). The model handles document parsing, HTML table extraction, LaTeX formula recognition, image-to-SVG conversion, and multilingual text including Tibetan and Kannada — capabilities that go considerably beyond classical optical character recognition. That a single point release ships both a Meta segmentation model and a document parser from a Chinese social platform illustrates how rapidly open weights are proliferating across geographies and use cases.

The remainder of v0.4.2 is a dense cluster of bug fixes, most invisible to end users but revealing about the project's design philosophy. A recurring theme is *torch-free* loading: both LFM2-VL (from Liquid AI, a Cambridge-based startup) and DOTS-MOCR had processor code that implicitly required PyTorch, pulling in a large, CUDA-linked dependency that mlx-vlm deliberately avoids. Three separate patches were needed for Alibaba Group's (BABA) Qwen3.5, a *mixture-of-experts* vision-language model — the fixes covered processor registration, a secondary MoE processor path, and a dtype mismatch in the model's *RMSNorm* layer. Mistral AI's Magistral and Alphabet's (GOOGL) PaliGemma 2 each required one targeted patch. The cumulative picture is of a project absorbing the output of six distinct AI laboratories through an interface as simple as `uv pip install -U mlx-vlm`.

concepts.definition: An AI system that jointly processes images and text, enabling tasks like visual question answering, image captioning, and document understanding. Unlike text-only large language models, VLMs include a vision encoder that converts image pixels into representations the language model can reason over.

A chip design central to Apple's M-series processors in which the CPU and GPU share a single pool of high-bandwidth RAM rather than having separate memory banks. This eliminates the data-copy overhead that slows inference on conventional GPU setups, making it practical to run large models on a laptop.

A computer vision capability in which a model can identify and isolate any object or concept specified in plain text, without being limited to a fixed set of pre-trained categories. SAM3 extends this to four million concepts, a significant advance over the click-based or region-based prompts used by earlier segmentation models.

Optical character recognition that goes beyond reading plain printed text. A multimodal OCR model can parse document structure, extract HTML tables, recognize mathematical notation, convert visual charts to structured formats like SVG, and handle diverse scripts — integrating vision and language reasoning throughout.

A neural network architecture in which a large number of specialized sub-networks are trained together but only a small subset is activated for any given input. This lets a model have a large total parameter count — improving quality — while keeping the computational cost per inference close to that of a much smaller model.

Root Mean Square Layer Normalization, a computationally efficient variant of the normalization layers used throughout modern transformer models. A dtype mismatch — the layer returning outputs in a different numerical precision than its inputs — can cause silent numerical errors or crashes, which is what the Qwen3.5 fix addressed.

A design goal in mlx-vlm meaning that models and their processors should load and run using only the MLX stack, without requiring PyTorch to be installed. Since PyTorch is a large dependency with CUDA ties, removing it keeps the Mac-native environment lean and avoids version conflicts.

A compression technique that reduces a model's memory footprint and speeds up inference by storing its weights in lower-precision formats — for example, 4-bit integers instead of 16-bit floats. Quantization makes models designed for data-center hardware fit within the memory of a consumer laptop, at a modest cost in accuracy.

repos.summary: The primary library for running vision-language models on Apple Silicon via the MLX framework. Supports over thirty model families with features including a FastAPI inference server, LoRA fine-tuning, speculative decoding, and KV cache quantization. Maintained by Blaize Appolinary with contributions from the broader open-source ML community.

Meta's open-weights foundation model for promptable segmentation in images and videos, succeeding SAM2. SAM3 extends click-based segmentation with open-vocabulary text-driven identification across four million object categories, and includes a tracker mode that serves as a drop-in API replacement for SAM2. Its license is more restrictive than SAM2's Apache 2.0.

A three-billion-parameter vision-language model from Xiaohongshu's research lab, specialized for document and scene OCR. Supports multilingual text, LaTeX formula parsing, HTML table extraction, and image-to-SVG conversion. A companion SVG variant is designed specifically for converting charts, UI layouts, and scientific figures into editable vector format.

ticker_aapl.name: Apple Inc.
ticker_aapl.blurb: Apple designs and markets consumer electronics (iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch), software, and digital services. The iPhone remains the dominant revenue driver, but the Services segment — comprising the App Store, Apple Music, iCloud, Apple Pay, and licensing — has grown into a high-margin business that Wall Street values separately. Apple commands one of the highest brand loyalty rates in consumer technology and operates a tightly integrated hardware-software ecosystem.
ticker_aapl.recent: Apple reported FY2025 revenue of approximately $400 billion. The company has faced headwinds from slowing iPhone upgrade cycles in mature markets and regulatory pressure on App Store commissions in both the US and EU. Apple Intelligence, its generative AI suite, launched in late 2024 but has not yet materially re-accelerated upgrade cycles. Paul Pelosi sold 45,000 shares of AAPL according to the January 2026 PTR disclosure — the largest single sale in the filing by share count.

ticker_meta.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
ticker_meta.blurb: Meta Platforms, headquartered in Menlo Park, California, operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Threads — collectively the largest social-media ecosystem in the world by monthly active users. The company generates the vast majority of its revenue through digital advertising, using detailed behavioural data to target ads across its platforms. After a painful 2022 in which shares fell roughly 65% amid a revenue slowdown and ballooning metaverse losses, Meta executed a dramatic turnaround by cutting costs, boosting margins, and rapidly integrating AI-driven ad ranking tools (Advantage+) that demonstrably improved advertiser returns. CEO Mark Zuckerberg declared 2023 a 'Year of Efficiency' and the company followed through. By late 2025 Meta was simultaneously the most profitable it had ever been and the most aggressive in AI infrastructure spending, committing up to $65 billion in capex for 2025 and raising that figure to as much as $145 billion for 2026.
ticker_meta.recent: Meta reached an all-time high near $796 per share in September 2025. The stock declined approximately 24–28% from that peak through April 2026, with the primary investor concern being the scale of the 2026 capital-expenditure commitment — up to $145 billion — and uncertainty about whether AI-driven revenue would materialise at the pace required to justify it. Quarterly earnings remained strong through the period, but multiple compression drove share-price weakness.

ticker_baba.name: Alibaba Group Holding Limited
ticker_baba.blurb: Alibaba Group is a Chinese multinational technology company specializing in e-commerce, retail, cloud computing, and digital media. It operates major platforms like Taobao, Tmall, and Alibaba.com, and is a leader in China's online retail market. The company also has a significant presence in cloud services through Alibaba Cloud and in digital payments via Ant Group.
ticker_baba.recent: In the past 30 days, Alibaba's stock has seen upward movement driven by positive sentiment around its cloud business and cost-cutting measures. The company reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings, with revenue growth in its core commerce and cloud segments. Analysts have noted improved investor confidence amid regulatory easing in China.

ticker_googl.name: Alphabet Inc. (Class A)
ticker_googl.blurb: Alphabet is the parent company of Google, the world's dominant search engine, as well as YouTube, the Google Cloud Platform, and a portfolio of moonshot bets (Waymo, DeepMind, Verily). Search advertising accounts for the majority of revenue, but the cloud division has grown into a multi-billion-dollar profit centre. Alphabet is also a leading player in generative AI, having developed the Gemini family of large language models and integrated them across its product suite.
ticker_googl.recent: Alphabet reported FY2025 revenue of approximately $370 billion, with Google Cloud crossing $50 billion annually. The company has faced antitrust scrutiny in both the US and EU, with a US federal court ruling in 2024 that Google holds an illegal monopoly in general search. Despite regulatory headwinds, the stock has benefited from AI-driven search enhancements and strong cloud growth. Paul Pelosi exercised call options with a $150 strike (purchased January 2025, exercised January 2026) gaining approximately 75% over the period.
